findings.description: The default CA bundle path is now used directly without passing through extract_zipped_paths, so when requests is loaded from a zip archive the certifi path points inside the zip and is not a real file.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests and certifi are imported from a zip or pex archive and a request is made with default verify. certifi.where() returns a path inside the archive, so os.path.exists(cert_loc) is False and the code raises OSError. Mechanism: the removed call was the only step that extracted the bundle to a temporary real file, so the call is not unused in zipped installs. Impact: every HTTPS request fails in such deployments.
